example.problem: Prove that the product (1 + 1/1)(1 + 1/2)... is even
work: Multiply: the k in the denominator cancels the (k+1) in the next numerator
Conclusion: 2024 is even, so the product is even. Q.E.D.

probe.problem: Write the conclusion sentence that would end a proof that a product is even.
probe.hint: See the example for the pattern.

learner_message: In an integer proof, state the pattern and finish with a conclusion sentence. The last line earns the mark.
